changes_made.explanation: Added Video Question Answering as a secondary NLG task since the paper also evaluates on TGIF-QA benchmark. Simplified outputs description and removed redundant phrasing.
Normalized metric variants to base forms (BLEU-4 → BLEU, ROUGE-L → ROUGE) following simplification guidelines
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper; only automatic metrics were used

overall_notes: The paper focuses on video-grounded dialogue systems and video QA using neural module networks. It evaluates NLG outputs using standard automatic metrics but does not conduct human or LLM-as-judge evaluations. The extraction was generally accurate, with minor normalization needed for metrics.
